sentences.en: I was determined to fulfill my duties at any cost.
sentences.zh: 我决心不惜一切代价履行我的职责。

sentences.en: No matter what may come, I will do my duty.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么，我都将尽我的责任。

sentences.en: The duty must be discharged by every one of you.
sentences.zh: 你们每个人都必须完成自己的义务。

senses.zh: 值班的，作为一种义务的
